This is a standard AUR PKGBUILD for pele-git, a Node.js Mermaid renderer. The sha256sums=('SKIP') is normal and required for VCS sources. The prepare() function runs npm ci, build() runs npm run build, and package() copies dist/ and package.json into /usr/lib/node_modules/pele. All operations are confined to standard packaging paths and the upstream build system. No suspicious network requests, obfuscated code, eval/base64 usage, or data exfiltration was found.
